source_record.passage_text: Urban tree planting programs are often judged by the number of trees installed, but survival matters more than installation. In a five-year study of three neighborhoods, trees planted with regular watering survived at nearly twice the rate of trees planted without follow-up care. The researchers therefore recommend pairing planting campaigns with maintenance plans rather than treating planting day as the endpoint.
